record.name: Outlaw
record.description: You are a criminal, rebel, or someone who has chosen to live outside the law. Whether you're a wanted fugitive, a freedom fighter, or simply someone who doesn't play by society's rules, you've learned to survive in the shadows. Your skills in stealth, deception, and combat make you dangerous, while your network of criminal contacts provides you with resources and information.

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.description: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of criminals. You know how to get messages to and from the criminal underworld, even to people you haven't met in person. Your criminal contacts can provide you with information about the local underworld, help you find fences for stolen goods, or assist with other criminal activities.

effects.notes: Access to criminal underworld contacts and information
Knowledge of criminal communication methods and safe houses

traits: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
I am incredibly slow to trust.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation.
I use multisyllabic words that others don't understand.
I have a strong sense of fair play.
I am haunted by memories of war.
I don't talk about the thing that torments me.
I idolize a particular hero of my faction and refer to them constantly.
ideals: Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, both for me and for others.
Independence. I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do.
Justice. I bring criminals to justice.
Fairness. I never kill a target who has surrendered.
Power. I will do whatever it takes to become powerful.
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy.
bonds: I'm on the run from a crime lord I crossed.
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
I have a family to provide for.
I owe a debt to the person who trained me.
I am searching for my former master.
flaws: I can't resist a pretty face.
When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between my friends and my mission, I'll choose my mission.
I'll do anything for a big payday.
I am haunted by the memory of a bounty that went wrong.
I am a sucker for a pretty face.
